name: recall
description: Look something up in FRED's memory: a topic, a person, or an earlier conversation. With no query it lists everything FRED has learned about the user; with days it reads back the recent conversation.

query.description: what to look up (a topic, person or event); empty = list everything FRED knows about the user

days.description: instead of searching: read the recent conversation (1 = today, 2 = since yesterday)

examples: what do you remember about my dentist appointment
do you remember what I told you about my sister
what did we talk about yesterday
what do you know about me
when did I mention the physics project
what was that thing I said last week about the trip
